title: God Items ResourcePack
description: A free dedicated resourcepack for a plugin that adds godly weapons.
body:
## 【**GOD ITEMS ResourcePack**】

**This ResourcePack is dedicated for the GodItems plugin my team made, you can access it through our discord.**


> You can also use this ResourcePack for your own plugins if you wish to, **refer to the Custom Model Datas at the very bottom**.

---

[![Discord Invite Link](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/35032d7c2455b0c3dde8ced29bd61a20a9f9dffc.png)](https://discord.gg/VMArBjf7WG)


<details>
<summary>QnA</summary>

## QnA
### Q: Where can I get the plugin this is made for?
That plugin is in a external website, you can [join our Discord Server](https://discord.gg/VMArBjf7WG).

### Q: When can I use your resourcepack?
You can use it for plugins (if you have a config that allows you to manually name the CMDs), videos, or personal use so long as you give me credit when needed.

For plugins, you can find the CMDs down below.

### Q: My resourcepack is [insert problem here]
You can [join our Discord Server](https://discord.gg/VMArBjf7WG) and make a post in [#🪲●➤𝐵𝓊𝑔-𝑅𝑒𝓅𝑜𝓇𝓉𝓈](https://discord.com/channels/1505203990269268172/1505207356080914442).

### Q: Can I use the models in the resourcepack?
You can refer to the first **Q**, if you mean extracting the models to use for a different purpose, **then no**.

### Q: Can I make a showcase of this resourcepack?
I'd be surprised as to why, but I would be honored, feel free to do so (make sure to link it too).

### Q: Will this resourcepack be updated to different versions?
Possibly, but for now I'll stick to 1.21.11, I might change my mind.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Custom Model Datas</summary>

## CMDs for Plugin Compatibility
- God Mace: 1001
- God Spear: 1002
- God Sword: 1003

The tiered weapons (Sword and Spear) have to be netherite.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Credits</summary>

And mojang for Minecraft

</details>
